XSS-REFLECTED.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
XSS-REFLECTED.description_template: '{param}' parametri foydalanuvchi kiritgan ma'lumotni sanitizatsiyasiz HTTP javobiga qaytaradi. Payload '{payload}' muvaffaqiyatli aks ettirildi. Bu hujumchiga ixtiyoriy JavaScript kodini qurbonning brauzerida bajarish imkonini beradi.
XSS-REFLECTED.impact: Hujumchi foydalanuvchi sessiyasini o'g'irlashi (session hijacking), sayt mazmunini o'zgartirishi (defacement), fishing hujumlari uyushtirishi yoki keylogger o'rnatishi mumkin.
XSS-REFLECTED.remediation:
1. Barcha foydalanuvchi kiritgan ma'lumotlarni chiqishda kontekstga mos encode qiling (HTML entity encoding: < > & ").
2. Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header qo'shing: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'
3. HttpOnly va Secure cookie atributlarini o'rnating.
4. Zamonaviy framework'larning avtomatik escaping mexanizmlaridan foydalaning.

SQLI-ERROR.title: SQL Injection (Error-Based)
SQLI-ERROR.description_template: '{param}' parametriga '{payload}' payloadi yuborilganda ma'lumotlar bazasi xato xabari qaytarildi: '{evidence}'. Bu parametr SQL so'roviga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'shilmoqda.
SQLI-ERROR.impact: Hujumchi barcha ma'lumotlar bazasi ma'lumotlarini o'qishi, o'zgartirishi yoki o'chirishi mumkin. Autentifikatsiyani chetlab o'tish, server ustida buyruq bajarish (xosting konfiguratsiyasiga bog'liq) mumkin.
SQLI-ERROR.remediation:
1. Prepared Statements (parameterized queries) ishlatib, foydalanuvchi kiritmalarini SQL so'rovidan ajrating.
2. ORM framework'laridan foydalaning.
3. Minimal imtiyoz tamoyiliga rioya qiling (DB foydalanuvchisi faqat zarur ruxsatlarga ega bo'lsin).
4. WAF (Web Application Firewall) o'rnating.

SQLI-BOOLEAN.title: SQL Injection (Boolean-Based Blind)
SQLI-BOOLEAN.description_template: '{param}' parametriga boolean-based SQLi payloadi ({payload}) yuborilganda javob xatti-harakatida farq aniqlandi. True shartida: {true_length} bayt, False shartida: {false_length} bayt.
SQLI-BOOLEAN.impact: Hujumchi savollar ketma-ketligi orqali butun ma'lumotlar bazasi tarkibini (foydalanuvchi ma'lumotlari, parollar, konfiguratsiya) olishi mumkin.
SQLI-BOOLEAN.remediation:
1. Prepared Statements (parameterized queries) foydalaning.
2. Kirish ma'lumotlarini validatsiya qiling.
3. Xato xabarlarini foydalanuvchiga ko'rsatmang.
4. Ma'lumotlar bazasi foydalanuvchisi imtiyozlarini cheklang.

MISSING-CSP.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
MISSING-CSP.description_template: '{url}' sahifasida Content-Security-Policy HTTP header'i yo'q. Bu XSS hujumlarining ta'sirini kuchaytiradi.
MISSING-CSP.impact: CSP yo'qligi XSS hujumlarini osonlashtiradi, chunki brauzer qaysi manbalarga ishonish kerakligini bilmaydi.
MISSING-CSP.remediation: Content-Security-Policy header'ini qo'shing: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:

MISSING-HSTS.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
MISSING-HSTS.description_template: '{url}' saytida Strict-Transport-Security header'i yo'q. HTTPS sahifasida HSTS bo'lmasa, foydalanuvchilar SSL stripping hujumiga zaif bo'ladi.
MISSING-HSTS.impact: Hujumchi SSL stripping orqali HTTPS ulanishni HTTP'ga tushirib, trafik ma'lumotlarini o'qishi mumkin (Man-in-the-Middle).
MISSING-HSTS.remediation: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload header'ini qo'shing.

MISSING-XFRAME.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
MISSING-XFRAME.description_template: '{url}' sahifasida X-Frame-Options yoki CSP frame-ancestors yo'q. Sahifa iframe ichiga joylashtirilishi mumkin.
MISSING-XFRAME.impact: Clickjacking hujumi: hujumchi sahifani ko'rinmas iframe orqali boshqa saytga joylashtirishi va foydalanuvchi tugmachalarini hijack qilishi mumkin.
MISSING-XFRAME.remediation: X-Frame-Options: DENY yoki X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN header'ini qo'shing. Yoki CSP: frame-ancestors 'self' dan foydalaning.

CSRF-MISSING-TOKEN.title: Missing CSRF Token in POST Form
CSRF-MISSING-TOKEN.description_template: '{form_url}' manzilidagi POST forma CSRF tokenisiz. Formada {input_count} ta input mavjud. Bu forma {is_sensitive} amal bajaradi.
CSRF-MISSING-TOKEN.impact: Hujumchi foydalanuvchi nomidan noma'lum harakatlarni bajarishi mumkin (pul o'tkazish, parol o'zgartirish, ma'lumot o'chirish).
CSRF-MISSING-TOKEN.remediation:
1. Har bir forma uchun noyob, sirli CSRF token qo'shing.
2. Django: {% csrf_token %}, Laravel: @csrf, Express: csurf middleware.
3. SameSite=Strict cookie atributidan foydalaning.
4. Double Submit Cookie patternini qo'llang.

CORS-WILDCARD.title: CORS Wildcard Origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)
CORS-WILDCARD.description_template: '{url}' manzilida Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * sozlangan. Ixtiyoriy domen ushbu resursga cross-origin so'rov yuborishi mumkin.
CORS-WILDCARD.impact: Istagan veb-sayt foydalanuvchi nomidan so'rov yuborib, maxfiy ma'lumotlarni o'qishi mumkin (agar autentifikatsiya token-asosida bo'lmasa).
CORS-WILDCARD.remediation: Kerakli domenlarni aniq ko'rsating: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://yourdomain.com. Wildcard (*) ishlatmang, ayniqsa autentifikatsiya talab qiladigan API'larda.

INFO-ENV-FILE.title: Sensitive File Exposed: .env
INFO-ENV-FILE.description_template: '{url}' manzilida .env fayli ochiq holda mavjud. Bu faylda ma'lumotlar bazasi paroli, API kalitlar va boshqa maxfiy ma'lumotlar bo'lishi mumkin.
INFO-ENV-FILE.impact: Hujumchi maxfiy kalit va parollarni o'qib, to'liq tizimga kirish huquqiga ega bo'lishi mumkin.
INFO-ENV-FILE.remediation:
1. .env faylini web root'dan tashqariga ko'chiring.
2. Nginx/Apache konfiguratsiyasida .env fayllariga kirishni bloklang.
3. .gitignore'ga .env qo'shing.
4. Muhitni ifloslantiruvchi ma'lumotlarni environment variables orqali bering.

INFO-GIT-CONFIG.title: Git Repository Exposed
INFO-GIT-CONFIG.description_template: '{url}' manzilida .git/config fayli ochiq. Butun git repository tiklash mumkin bo'lishi ehtimoli bor.
INFO-GIT-CONFIG.impact: Hujumchi manba kodi, git tarixini, maxfiy konfiguratsiya ma'lumotlarini yuklab olishi mumkin.
INFO-GIT-CONFIG.remediation:
1. .git papkasiga veb-kirish ni to'sing.
2. Nginx: location ~ /\.git { deny all; }
3. Apache: RedirectMatch 404 /\.git
4. Production serverda git history bo'lmasligi kerak.

SSL-EXPIRED.title: SSL Certificate Expired
SSL-EXPIRED.description_template: '{url}' saytining SSL sertifikati muddati tugagan. Muddati: {expiry_date}. {days_expired} kun oldin eskirgan.
SSL-EXPIRED.impact: Brauzerlar ogohlantirish ko'rsatadi, foydalanuvchilar saytga kirishdan bosh tortishi mumkin. MITM hujumlariga zaif.
SSL-EXPIRED.remediation: Sertifikatni darhol yangilang. Let's Encrypt bepul sertifikat beradi: certbot renew.

SSL-DEPRECATED-TLS.title: Deprecated TLS Protocol Supported
SSL-DEPRECATED-TLS.description_template: '{url}' serveri {protocol} protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlamoqda. Bu protokol xavfli deb e'lon qilingan.
SSL-DEPRECATED-TLS.impact: POODLE, BEAST, DROWN kabi protokol-darajasidagi hujumlarga zaif.
SSL-DEPRECATED-TLS.remediation: Server konfiguratsiyasida faqat TLS 1.2 va TLS 1.3'ga ruxsat bering. SSLv2, SSLv3, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1 ni o'chiring.

OPEN-PORT.title: Unnecessary Open Port Detected
OPEN-PORT.description_template: Port {port}/{protocol} ochiq: {service} ({version}). Bu servis internet'ga ochiq bo'lmasligi kerak.
OPEN-PORT.impact: Ochiq port hujum yuzasini kengaytiradi. Ushbu servis versiyasida ma'lum zaifliklar bo'lishi mumkin.
OPEN-PORT.remediation:
1. Keraksiz portlarni yoping (firewall qoidalari).
2. Faqat zarur portlarni (80, 443) internetga oching.
3. Boshqa portlarni faqat VPN orqali yoki IP cheklash bilan oching.
4. Servis versiyasini yangilang.

TECH-DISCLOSURE.title: Technology Version Disclosure
TECH-DISCLOSURE.description_template: Server yoki CMS versiya ma'lumotini ochiq ko'rsatyapti: {technology} {version}. Bu header orqali: {header}.
TECH-DISCLOSURE.impact: Hujumchi aniq versiyaga oid ma'lum zaifliklarni maqsadli qidirishi mumkin.
TECH-DISCLOSURE.remediation:
1. Server: ServerTokens Prod (Apache), server_tokens off (Nginx).
2. X-Powered-By headerini o'chiring.
3. CMS generator meta tag'ini olib tashlang.
4. Versiyani oshkor qiluvchi fayllarni o'chiring.

MISSING-SPF.title: Missing SPF DNS Record
MISSING-SPF.description_template: '{domain}' domenida SPF DNS yozuvi topilmadi. Email spoofing mumkin.
MISSING-SPF.impact: Hujumchi sizning domeningizdan elektron pochta jo'natishini taqlid qilishi mumkin (email spoofing / phishing).
MISSING-SPF.remediation: SPF yozuvini qo'shing: v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all (email provayderingizga mos ravishda o'zgartiring).

MISSING-DMARC.title: Missing DMARC DNS Record
MISSING-DMARC.impact: Email phishing hujumlariga zaif. Hujumchi sizning domen nomingizdan phishing xatlari yuborishi mumkin.
MISSING-DMARC.remediation: DMARC yozuvini qo'shing: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@yourdomain.com

INSECURE-COOKIE.title: Insecure Cookie Configuration
INSECURE-COOKIE.impact: HttpOnly yo'q bo'lsa JavaScript orqali cookie o'qilishi mumkin (XSS hujumini kuchaytiradi). Secure yo'q bo'lsa HTTP orqali uzatilishi mumkin.

ROBOTS-SENSITIVE.title: Sensitive Paths Disclosed in robots.txt
ROBOTS-SENSITIVE.description_template: robots.txt faylida {count} ta Disallow yo'li topildi. Bu yo'llar maxfiy papkalar yoki admin panellar bo'lishi mumkin.
ROBOTS-SENSITIVE.impact: robots.txt aslida qidiruv robotlaridan yashirishga mo'ljallangan, lekin hujumchi bu yo'llarni maqsadli tekshirishi mumkin.
ROBOTS-SENSITIVE.remediation: robots.txt'da maxfiy yo'llarni ro'yxatlamang. Kirish cheklovi server darajasida (authentication/authorization) bo'lishi kerak.

MISSING-XCONTENT.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
MISSING-XCONTENT.impact: Brauzer MIME-type sniffing orqali xavfli fayllarni (masalan JavaScript) noto'g'ri bajarishi mumkin.

INFO-BACKUP-FILE.title: Backup or Configuration File Exposed
INFO-BACKUP-FILE.description_template: '{url}' manzilida backup/konfiguratsiya fayli topildi: {filename}. HTTP {status_code} javobi qaytarildi.
INFO-BACKUP-FILE.impact: Maxfiy ma'lumotlar, manba kodi, ma'lumotlar bazasi zaxirasi oshkor bo'lishi mumkin.
INFO-BACKUP-FILE.remediation: Backup fayllarni web root'dan tashqariga ko'chiring yoki o'chiring. Veb-serverda bunday fayllarga kirishni bloklang.
